# Beetmover manifests rename the bucket-path input without changing destination prefixes

All eight owned manifests replace the top-level s3_bucket_paths name with bucket_paths. The patch keeps the candidate and nightly publication prefixes and updates comments to describe generic buckets and per-artifact mapping fields. Comm kind declarations still select these artifact-map files. This source change establishes the input-name transition, not a verified change of storage backend, upload permissions or successful graph execution. Downstream Gecko transform implementation and historical cross-tree compatibility remain bounded unread dependencies.

Scope: Thunderbird artifact-map schema inputs.
